title: Returns and Seller Refund Terms of the Northgate Marketplace Seller Programs
content:
**Returns schedule.** For Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, the return window, where returns go, who pays return shipping, the most restocking a seller may withhold, the seller's answer and refund times, the shipping refund and the tender and rounding of refunds are set per seller program. The six seller programs of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee are Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled, Northgate Marketplace Pro Seller, Northgate Marketplace Fulfilled by Northgate, Northgate Marketplace Freight Seller, Northgate Marketplace Certified Renewed and Northgate Marketplace International Seller; the columns below carry their names without the Northgate Marketplace prefix.

| Term | Seller-Fulfilled | Pro Seller | Fulfilled by Northgate | Freight Seller | Certified Renewed | International Seller |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after delivery within which a return can be requested | 30 | 30 | 90 | 30 | 90 | 30 |
| Where returned items go | the seller | the seller | Northgate, at a store or by mail | the seller | the seller | the seller's US return address |
| Who pays return shipping when the buyer changed their mind | the buyer | the seller | Northgate | the buyer | the seller | the buyer |
| Who pays return shipping when the item is defective, damaged, wrong or not as described | the seller | the seller | Northgate | the seller | the seller | the seller |
| Highest restocking fee a seller may withhold on an opened item returned for a change of mind, percent | 20 | 0 | 0 | 15 | 0 | 20 |
| Business days within which the seller must answer a return request (authorize, refund without return, or decline with a reason); 0 where Northgate handles returns | 2 | 2 | 0 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Business days after the return is delivered to the seller within which the seller must refund; 0 where Northgate refunds at drop-off | 2 | 2 | 0 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| The seller may offer a partial refund to keep the item | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The item can be dropped off at a Northgate store for return | No | No | Yes | No | No | No |
| The original shipping charge is refunded with a seller-fault return | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The original shipping charge is refunded with a change-of-mind return | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Tender for seller refunds | original payment | original payment | original payment | original payment | original payment | original payment |
| Channel through which the buyer contacts the seller | marketplace messages | marketplace messages | Northgate support | marketplace messages | marketplace messages | marketplace messages |
| Rounding applied to refunds and reimbursements | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent |

**Points of reading.**

- The restocking row is a percentage of the price of the returned units: 20 percent is the most a Seller-Fulfilled or International Seller may withhold, 15 percent the most for a Freight Seller, and 0 on the other three programs.
- Return windows are 30 calendar days on Seller-Fulfilled, Pro Seller, Freight Seller and International Seller and 90 calendar days on Fulfilled by Northgate and Certified Renewed.
- Answer and refund times are 2 business days on every seller-handled program; the 0 shown for Fulfilled by Northgate reflects that Northgate handles those returns and refunds at drop-off.
